-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2e-G1 (addendum V2e, debt D56): the
-- residual of addendum V2c.7, measured by the W10 design seat. An initializer
-- removes the gate module's two post-command linters, and a macro replaces the
-- gate command with #check 1, so no in-tree pass runs and lake build passes.
-- The executable runs neither and refuses the initializer and the macro from
-- the raw entries this module records.
import WhatwgTest.Audit.AxiomGate

open Lean Elab Command

initialize
  lintersRef.modify fun linters =>
    linters.filter (·.name != `WhatwgTest.Audit.rootGateCommandCheck)
  moduleLintersRef.modify fun linters =>
    linters.filter (·.name != `WhatwgTest.Audit.rootCommandsCheck)

macro_rules | `(#whatwg_streams_axiom_gate) => `(#check 1)
